mog2-foreground-mask: O(H·W) thời gian; O(H·W·K) bộ nhớ nền (K = số Gauss/pixel). **[sim]**: O(H·W), 1 giá trị nền/px.
temporal-motion-gate: O(H·W·R) R = số mốc (≤2) + O(H·W·k²) morph; O(H·W·S) bộ nhớ lịch sử. **[sim]**: R=1, S=2.
roi-strict-context-mask: O(compPx) đếm; O(H·W) tiền xử lý mask context (cache theo ROI). **space** O(1) ngoài cache mask O(H·W); **[sim]**: O(compPx).
foreground-morphology: O(H·W·k²) mỗi pass (k = cạnh kernel). **space** O(H·W) mask trung gian; **[sim]**: O(H·W·9) hai pass.
contour-geometry-filter: O(N·P), N contour × P px/contour. **space** O(N·P); **[sim]**: O(N·P) trên lưới nhỏ.
motion-echo-suppression: O(N²) cặp + O(N·T) owner. **space** O(N); **[sim]**: O(N²), N≤10.
occlusion-group-guard: O(T²) cặp eligible + O(G·members) covering. **space** O(G+T); **[sim]**: O(T²).
watershed-blob-partition: O(blobPx·k) gần đúng. **space** O(blobPx) label map; **[sim]**: O(blobPx·S), S seed.
lapjv-assignment: LAPJV ~O(n³). **space** O(n²) ma trận + O(n) gán; **[sim]**: exhaustive O(n!) với n≤5 — **chỉ cho demo**, ghi rõ khác biệt.
hsv-lab-descriptor: O(compPx + 416). **space** O(416·S); **[sim]**: O(compPx + 6) — demo 1 hist 6-bin H.
slot-roi-precompute: O(H·W) mỗi slot một lần. **space** O(H·W·S) mask; **[sim]**: O(R) raster ô lưới.
ensemble-threshold-voting: O(V·R + S) — V=25 biến thể × R px ROI (threshold+mask+count), S slot cho vote/rescue/edge. **space** O(S) votes/evidence + O(S·R) `vote_masks` khi `selective_line_filter=False` (True → O(R) buffer tái dùng); **[sim]**: O(V) + O(1) space.
border-line-filter: O(R + C + P_sel) — R px ROI quét, C component kiểm, P_sel px cho `fitLine`+`distanceTransform` khi selective. **space** O(R) label map + O(C) stats; **[sim]**: O(R) raster + O(C) — bỏ P_sel (xóa nguyên component).
core-rescue-vote: O(1) (≤7 phép so sánh trên 4 field). **space** O(1); **[sim]**: O(1).
temporal-smoothing-dwell: O(S) mỗi call; (b) O(S·evidence). **space** O(S); **[sim]**: O(S).
slot-overlap-geometry: O(P) polygon ops (`intersectConvexConvex`, `pointPolygonTest`, `boundingRect`). **space** O(1) ngoài polygon; **[sim]**: O(cells) raster.
slot-track-batch-match: LAPJV O(n³) + build O(T·S). **space** O(T·S) ma trận; **[sim]**: exhaustive O(n!) n≤5.
vision-primary-fusion: O(S) mỗi vision tick. **space** O(S); **[sim]**: O(S).
stop-dwell-detection: O(n) n = số mẫu trong cửa sổ (bounded). **space** O(n) mẫu cửa sổ; **[sim]**: O(n).
departure-token-lifecycle: O(1)/token + O(tokens·candidates) cleanup. **space** O(tokens + evidence); **[sim]**: O(n).
predeparture-candidate-guard: O(F·B), F unbound × B bindings. **space** O(F·B) choices; **[sim]**: O(F·B).
recovery-batch-assignment: O(n³) + O(T·F) gap. **space** O(T·F); **[sim]**: exhaustive O(n!) n≤5.
world-projection-anchor: O(1)/điểm; O(T) cho T track. **space** O(1); **[sim]**: O(1).
handoff-lapjv-matching: O(n³) + build O(E·T). **space** O(E·T); **[sim]**: exhaustive n≤5.
overlap-simultaneous-pairing: O(T_A·T_B) build + O(P log P) sort. **space** O(T_A+T_B+P); **[sim]**: O(n²).
merge-alias-resolution: chain lookup O(depth) ~O(1) amortized; merge O(gallery+traj). **space** O(G) alias; **[sim]**: O(n).
homography-fit-distributed: O(n) DLT + O(n·iters) RANSAC. **space** O(n) pairs; **[sim]**: O(n) DLT 4 điểm.
calibration-load-validation: O(1) + O(P) validate polygon. **space** O(P); **[sim]**: O(1).
matching-distance-derivation: O(S·k²) minAreaRect (k=đỉnh/slot) + O(S log S) median. **space** O(S); **[sim]**: O(S).
latest-frame-mailbox: O(1) mỗi op; wait O(1) + blocking. **space** O(cam) pending; **[sim]**: O(events).
stale-evidence-health-gating: O(S) apply + O(1) gate mỗi job. **space** O(cam); **[sim]**: O(1).
replay-session-sync: O(1)/pair đọc; O(n) load CSV. **space** O(n) timings; **[sim]**: O(n).
